I answered Tobias in a thread in #central-random. The Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is **ticket PD-4821**. Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026 and said the import file was attached to that ticket.

I also passed on the problem flagged then: the import file labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. That needed sorting before anyone reimported, to avoid duplicates. Nothing I can see says whether it was fixed.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, and ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so it was fine to share.
